# superset_chart_cache_warmup (Resource)

Computes a chart and stores its result in the cache of Superset, so the first person to open it does not wait for the query. The warm-up runs when the resource is created and whenever `dashboard_id` or `triggers` change, for example after the data was loaded. The chart needs a query context, which charts saved in the UI have and `superset_chart.query_context` sets; a chart that cannot be computed does not fail the apply: the reason is reported as a warning and in `viz_error`. Destroying the resource does nothing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Compute the chart for the cache after every nightly load, in the context of the dashboard
# filters.
resource "superset_chart_cache_warmup" "sales_by_day" {
  chart_id     = superset_chart.sales_by_day.id
  dashboard_id = superset_dashboard.sales.id
  triggers = {
    loaded_at = var.last_load
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `chart_id` (Number) Identifier of the chart to compute. A change makes a new resource.

### Optional

- `dashboard_id` (Number) Identifier of a dashboard whose filters apply to the chart, so the cached result is the one the dashboard shows.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values whose change runs the warm-up again, for example the date of the last load.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Identifier of the chart, which identifies the resource as well.
- `viz_error` (String) Reason the chart could not be computed in the last run; null when it was.
- `viz_status` (String) Status Superset reported for the last run, `success` when the result was cached; null when the chart could not be computed.
